1. Heard Mr. N J Dutta, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. R J Baruah, learned Addl. PP,
Assam.
2.

By this application under Section 438 Cr.P.C., the applicant, namely, Rofikul Islam @ Rofiqul Islam has filed an application under Page No.# 2/2 section 438 Cr.P.C., with prayer for pre arrest bail in connection with South Salmara PS Case No.161/2023 under sections 417/493/376 IPC.

sentences.text: 3. Case diary called for is received and perused.

4. This court vide order dated 23.06.2023 granted interim bail to the applicant with a direction to appear before the I/O and the applicant has accordingly appeared and recorded his statement and he has been duly interrogated in the meantime.

5. Considered the materials so far collected against the present applicant including the statement of the victim recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C., which reflects that the victim has not specifically alleged commission of offence of rape upon her by the present applicant, however, there are certain allegations of being beaten by the brother and brother in law of the present applicant.
6. Upon perusal of the case diary, this court is of the view that no custodial interrogation shall be required inasmuch as the applicant has co-operated with the investigating agency.
Accordingly, the interim order dated 23.06.2023 granting interim bail to the above named applicant is hereby made absolute under the same terms and conditions.
7. The pre-arrest bail application stands disposed off.
